subtitle: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <compare> header (C++20). Phases C1-C5 (2026-05-17) shipped all 17 catalogued symbols: ordering category classes (C1) back-ported to C++11+ via the literal_zero_helper trick; helper meta-functions common_comparison_category + compare_three_way_result (C2); concepts three_way_comparable / three_way_comparable_with as SFINAE traits (C3); compare_three_way function object and the strong_order/weak_order/partial_order niebloids using the priority<N> + ADL-poison-pill pattern (C4); compare_*_order_fallback CPOs synthesising the appropriate category from `==` and `<` when the primary niebloid is ill-formed (C5). Phase C6 deferred — the floating-point special case in the strong_order / weak_order niebloids (deterministic total order over NaN bit patterns).
legend_blurb: Per-symbol coverage of the C++ <compare> header (C++20). Phases C1-C5 (2026-05-17) shipped all 17 catalogued symbols: ordering category classes (C1) back-ported to C++11+; helper meta-functions (C2); concepts three_way_comparable / three_way_comparable_with as SFINAE traits (C3); compare_three_way + strong_order/weak_order/partial_order niebloids (C4); the three compare_*_order_fallback synthesising CPOs (C5). Phase C6 deferred — FP-only special case in strong_order / weak_order for deterministic total order over NaN bit patterns.

symbols.name: partial_ordering
symbols.notes: Weakest of the three categories. Shipped Phase C1 (2026-05-17). Four static instances: less, equivalent, greater, unordered. Encodes the value as a signed-char (-1 / 0 / +1 / +2-sentinel-for-unordered). All six relational operators against literal 0 are provided in both directions; for the unordered state, every relational op returns false. The literal-0 trick uses internal::literal_zero_helper which is only constructible from the null-pointer-literal-conversion of 0 (preventing other integers from being silently accepted).
symbols.failure_reason: Requires C++11+ constexpr ctors and rvalue-friendly machinery; class itself works under any tier that supports those.

symbols.name: weak_ordering
symbols.notes: Middle category — total ordering allowing equivalent-but-distinct values (e.g. case-insensitive string compare). Shipped Phase C1. Three static instances: less, equivalent, greater. Implicit conversion to partial_ordering preserves the ordering state; never yields partial_ordering::unordered. Same literal-0 comparison surface as partial_ordering.

symbols.name: strong_ordering
symbols.notes: Strongest category — total ordering with substitutability. Shipped Phase C1. Four static instances: less, equal, equivalent, greater (equal and equivalent share the same value encoding per [cmp.strongord]/3). Implicit conversions to both weak_ordering and partial_ordering. Same literal-0 comparison surface as the other categories.

symbols.name: literal_zero_helper (internal)
symbols.notes: restd::internal helper, not in std. Pseudo-type accepting only the literal 0 (via the null-pointer-literal conversion to a pointer-to-self). Used as the RHS-of-comparison parameter type for the ordering category classes so that `cmp == 0`, `cmp < 0`, etc. compile while `cmp == 42` or `cmp == some_int_variable` does NOT — matching the C++20 spec for ordering-vs-0 inspection.

symbols.name: common_comparison_category
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C2 (2026-05-17). Variadic meta-function yielding the weakest common comparison category among Ts. Implemented as a recursive partial-spec fold over an internal pick_weaker<T, U> helper, with an internal cmp_rank<T> trait (strong = 0, weak = 1, partial = 2). Empty pack yields strong_ordering; any non-category input yields void (sticky void propagation through pick_weaker).

symbols.name: common_comparison_category_t
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C2 alongside the trait. Convenience alias gated on D_ENV_CPP_FEATURE_LANG_ALIAS_TEMPLATES (C++14+).

symbols.name: compare_three_way_result
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C2 as a SFINAE-detected trait. Primary template (gated on void_t) has no `type`; a partial spec (gated on D_ENV_LANG_IS_CPP20_OR_HIGHER) supplies `type` only when the const-lvalue <=> expression is well-formed. On C++11-17 the trait is intentionally ill-formed-when-used (no <=> operator at parse time). _U defaults to _T per the standard.

symbols.name: compare_three_way_result_t
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C2 alongside the trait. Convenience alias gated on alias-template support.

symbols.name: three_way_comparable
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C3 (2026-05-17). Trait inherits true_type when decltype(a <=> a) is well-formed AND its result is implicitly convertible to _Cat (default partial_ordering). Implementation: SFINAE-anchored partial-spec of internal::twc_impl, the partial-spec body gated on D_ENV_LANG_IS_CPP20_OR_HIGHER. On C++11-17 the trait always evaluates false (no <=> at parse time). _v variable-template alias on C++14+.
symbols.failure_reason: Trait is shipped on C++11+ but only meaningful on C++20+ (where operator<=> is a language feature). The full standard concept also requires __WeaklyEqualityComparableWith / __PartiallyOrderedWith which this restd back-port omits — covers the typical category-dispatch use-case but is technically less strict.

symbols.name: three_way_comparable_with
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C3 alongside three_way_comparable. Cross-type variant: requires BOTH (t <=> u) and (u <=> t) to be well-formed with results convertible to _Cat. The common-reference / common-type requirement from the full standard concept is omitted in this restd back-port. _v alias on C++14+.

symbols.name: compare_three_way
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C4 (2026-05-17). Stateless function object whose call operator returns t <=> u with the underlying result type. constexpr, noexcept-propagating, trailing-return decltype. Marker typedef `is_transparent = void` allows use as a heterogeneous comparator. Entire class definition gated on D_ENV_LANG_IS_CPP20_OR_HIGHER since the body requires the operator<=> language feature.
symbols.failure_reason: Body requires C++20 operator<=>. The class simply does not exist on C++11-17 tiers.

symbols.name: strong_order
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C4. Niebloid using the same priority<N> + ADL-poison-pill pattern as the ranges:: CPOs (R24). Dispatch hierarchy: priority<2> for ADL strong_order(t, u) cast through strong_ordering ctor; priority<1> for built-in <=> cast through strong_ordering ctor; otherwise ill-formed. The std-mandated floating-point special case (deterministic total order over NaN bit patterns) is NOT shipped — FP inputs that compare unordered will fail to convert from partial_ordering to strong_ordering. Definition gated on C++20 since the body uses <=>.
symbols.failure_reason: Body requires C++20 operator<=>. FP special case deferred to Phase C5.

symbols.name: weak_order
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C4 alongside strong_order. Same priority<N> + ADL pattern; result-cast target is weak_ordering. FP special case deferred (same scope notes as strong_order). Body gated on C++20.
symbols.failure_reason: Body requires C++20 operator<=>. FP special case deferred to Phase C5.

symbols.name: partial_order
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C4. Same priority<N> + ADL pattern; result-cast target is partial_ordering. Most permissive of the three _order niebloids: every category converts to partial_ordering via the implicit operator partial_ordering() on weak_ordering and strong_ordering, so user types whose <=> returns strong or weak ordering still work through path (c). Body gated on C++20.

symbols.name: compare_strong_order_fallback
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C5 (2026-05-17). Niebloid using priority<N> + trailing-return-SFINAE pattern. Priority<2> defers to the strong_order niebloid (which itself does ADL + built-in <=> dispatch); Priority<1> synthesises from `t == u` and `t < u` via a nested conditional yielding strong_ordering::equal / ::less / ::greater. The same-type constraint from the standard (decay_t<T> == decay_t<U>) is NOT enforced — back-port simplification. Body gated on C++20.
symbols.failure_reason: Body requires C++20 operator<=> in the priority<2> path; the synth path itself only needs == and <, but the file is gated as a unit.

symbols.name: compare_weak_order_fallback
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C5 alongside the strong variant. Same dispatch pattern; synth path returns weak_ordering::equivalent / ::less / ::greater. Body gated on C++20.

symbols.name: compare_partial_order_fallback
symbols.notes: Shipped Phase C5 alongside the other fallbacks. Synth path is one branch longer than strong/weak: tests both `t < u` AND `u < t` so it can produce partial_ordering::unordered when neither ordering holds. Body gated on C++20.
